findings.title: Waterings page crashes on a non-list response from GET /api/waterings (uncaught 'waterings.value?.reduce is not a function')
findings.expected: A malformed or non-array response shows an error message on the Waterings page
findings.actual: An uncaught TypeError 'waterings.value?.reduce is not a function' is thrown, navigation never completes, and the user stays on the previous page with no error shown
findings.evidence: {"url":"/waterings","alerts":[],"text":["Sunlight","Full sun","Partial shade","Shade","Notes","Add bed","All beds","North bed","Full sun","PLANTS","2","HARVESTED"],"pe":["waterings.value?.reduce is not a function"]} | {"url":"/waterings","alerts":[],"text":["Sunlight","Full sun","Partial shade","Shade","Notes","Add bed","All beds","North bed","Full sun","PLANTS","2","HARVESTED"],"pe":["waterings.value?.reduce is not a function"]}

findings.title: Bed filter on the Waterings page is lost on reload: the page writes ?bed_id= to the URL but reads only ?bed=
findings.expected: After choosing a bed in the filter and reloading (or sharing the URL /waterings?bed_id=1), the same bed stays selected and only its waterings are listed
findings.actual: After the reload the URL still says ?bed_id=1, but the filter goes back to 'All beds' and every bed's waterings are listed

findings.title: A small accepted amount is shown as '0 L'
findings.expected: An amount of 0.001 litres is either refused (the input's step/min is 0.1) or shown as a non-zero amount
findings.actual: The server stores 0.001 and the confirmation says 'Recorded 0 L on 10 Nov 2026.'
